module purpose: SPI controller that accepts bus requests (bus_req_i), holds configuration in internal control registers, buffers transmit/receive bytes in FIFOs, runs an rtx_engine that shifts SPI data and controls chip-selects, generates the SPI clock and data outputs, and reports status/RX data and interrupts via bus_rsp_o and irq_o.

use-case flows.value: control register fields (enable, cpha, cpol, prsc, cdiv, highspeed, irq enables) written from the bus
enqueue a transmit entry into the TX FIFO (wdata and we) which can start a transmission
bitwise transmit/receive sequencing by the transceiver FSM (rtx_engine) gated by spi_clk_en and using ctrl settings (CPOL/CPHA), shifting sreg and sampling sdi
status and readback returned on the bus (bus_rsp_o.data) including FIFO status and ctrl fields
RX FIFO readback to the bus (rx_fifo.re driven by bus reads) and RX data delivered to rx_fifo by rtx_engine.done
interrupt generation (irq_o) asserted from ctrl irq-enable bits gated with FIFO and engine status
configuration and engine/FIFO control state cleared when rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Control configuration (ctrl.enable, ctrl.cpha, ctrl.cpol, ctrl.prsc, ctrl.cdiv, ctrl.highspeed, ctrl.irq_*) — the SPI-mode, clock selection and IRQ-enable settings the block stores
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus-access process writes these fields from bus_req_i.data when a bus write to the control word occurs (bus_access assigns ctrl.* under the write branch; RTL lines 137-150). Each ctrl field is a held register (map: ctrl.<field> CLOCKED_BY clk_i at their write occurrences; e.g. ctrl.enable CLOCKED_BY at occurrence 3, line 140). These registers drive SPI timing and mode (clock_generator uses ctrl.prsc/ctrl.cdiv/ctrl.highspeed at lines 362-379; transceiver uses ctrl.enable/cpol/cpha at lines 281 and 299-309) and IRQ decisions (irq_generator uses ctrl.irq_* at lines 250-259). Therefore the integrity of these stored settings is established by the RTL: corruption would change clocking, phase/polarity, enabling and interrupt decisions. Evidence: assignments in bus_access (lines 137-150) and the map records showing ctrl.* derived from bus_req_i.data and stored (CLOCKED_BY clk_i) at the cited occurrences.

conceptual assets.concept: Transmit FIFO contents (words enqueued by the bus) that determine what is sent on SPI and whether an entry is a CS-control header
conceptual assets.reasoning: Bus writes place entries into the TX FIFO (tx_fifo.we and tx_fifo.wdata assigned from bus_req_i; RTL lines 211-214); the FIFO output (tx_fifo.rdata) is consumed by the transceiver: when rtx_engine reads the FIFO it checks tx_fifo.rdata(8) and either loads cs_ctrl or loads sreg and advances state (transceiver lines 286-295). Map evidence: tx_fifo.wdata DERIVES_FROM bus_req_i.data at occurrence 3 (line 213); tx_fifo.we is driven by the bus-write condition (GATED_BY at occurrence 3, line 212); tx_fifo.rdata is the FIFO's output (CONNECTS from tx_fifo_inst.rdata_o at occurrence 2, line 207) and is SOURCES to rtx_engine.cs_ctrl and rtx_engine.sreg (map: tx_fifo.rdata -> rtx_engine.cs_ctrl at line 290 and -> rtx_engine.sreg at line 292). Corrupting FIFO contents would alter which bytes are transmitted and could change CS selection or data sent on SPI, so integrity is Established.

conceptual assets.concept: Chip-select control (rtx_engine.cs_ctrl) — the stored select bits that determine which SPI chip-select line is driven low
conceptual assets.reasoning: The transceiver loads cs_ctrl from a TX-FIFO header when tx_fifo.rdata(8) = '1' (transceiver lines 288-293) and chip_select uses rtx_engine.cs_ctrl to drive spi_csn_o (lines 347-355). Map shows the FIFO-driven source (tx_fifo.rdata SOURCES rtx_engine.cs_ctrl at occurrence 4, line 290) and that rtx_engine.cs_ctrl is a clocked register (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4, line 290) whose bit 3 selects the active CS (chip_select SELECTED_BY/GATED_BY of rtx_engine.cs_ctrl at occurrence 7/6, lines 353-354). Integrity is Established because wrong cs_ctrl corrupts which external slave is selected. Evidence: RTL lines 288-295 and 347-355 and the map records cited.

conceptual assets.concept: Receive FIFO contents and delivered RX byte (rx_fifo) used for readback and IRQ decisions
conceptual assets.reasoning: The rtx_engine shifts in spi_dat_i into rtx_engine.sreg and, when a transfer completes, drives rx_fifo.wdata and rx_fifo.we (rtx_engine.sreg -> rx_fifo.wdata at line 244; rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done at line 245). The RX FIFO output (rx_fifo.rdata) is then made available to bus reads (bus_access read branch uses rx_fifo.rdata at line 174). Map evidence: rtx_engine.sreg is a registered value (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4, line 292); rx_fifo.wdata DERIVES_FROM rtx_engine.sreg at occurrence 3 (line 244); rx_fifo.we COPIES rtx_engine.done at occurrence 3 (line 245); rx_fifo.rdata is the FIFO output (CONNECTS from rx_fifo_inst.rdata_o at occurrence 3, line 239) used by the bus read path. Integrity is Established because corruption of received bytes or the FIFO path would return wrong data and affect IRQs.

conceptual assets.concept: Interrupt signal (irq_o) produced by the block from ctrl IRQ enables and FIFO/engine status
conceptual assets.reasoning: irq_o is registered inside the irq_generator process from ctrl.* and FIFO/engine status (RTL lines 250-259). Map: irq_o is CLOCKED_BY clk_i and at occurrence 3 (line 255) DERIVES_FROM the ctrl.irq_* fields and FIFO/engine signals (map lists ctrl.irq_idle, ctrl.irq_rx_avail, ctrl.irq_tx_empty, ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf, rtx_engine.busy, rx_fifo.avail, tx_fifo.avail, tx_fifo.half). ctrl.irq_rx_avail is itself a stored register (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3, line 146). rx_fifo.avail is provided by the FIFO sub-unit (CONNECTS from rx_fifo_inst.avail_o at occurrence 3, line 240). Corruption of the inputs or of irq_o would cause incorrect interrupt reporting; the RTL establishes this as a produced event used by the system.

conceptual assets.concept: SPI external signals (spi_dat_o, spi_clk_o, spi_csn_o) that the core drives into the physical SPI lines
conceptual assets.reasoning: These three ports are where the module's decisions leave the entity. spi_dat_o is driven from rtx_engine.sreg (assign at line 343; map: spi_dat_o DERIVES_FROM rtx_engine.sreg at occurrence 2, line 343). spi_clk_o is copied from rtx_engine.sck (assign at line 344; map: spi_clk_o COPIES rtx_engine.sck at occurrence 2, line 344). spi_csn_o is driven by chip_select from rtx_engine.cs_ctrl (lines 347-355; map: spi_csn_o is SELECTED_BY/GATED_BY rtx_engine.cs_ctrl at occurrence 4, line 354). The RTL therefore establishes that these ports export the module's SPI data, clock and chip-select decisions; their integrity is established by the assignment and selection statements cited.

conceptual assets.concept: SPI bit-clock gating and generation state (cdiv_cnt, spi_clk_en) that enables rtx_engine progress
conceptual assets.reasoning: The clock_generator produces spi_clk_en when ctrl.enable is set and either clkgen_i at the selected prescaler or ctrl.highspeed is active; when cdiv_cnt reaches ctrl.cdiv it pulses spi_clk_en (RTL lines 362-379). Map: cdiv_cnt is a stored counter (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 3, line 370) constrained by ctrl.cdiv (CONSTRAINS at occurrence 4, line 372), and spi_clk_en is a stored flag (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 6, line 368) whose gating depends on clkgen_i, ctrl.prsc and ctrl.highspeed (map: clkgen_i GATES cdiv_cnt/spi_clk_en at occurrence 2 line 371). The availability of spi_clk_en pulses is established by these RTL statements and is required for the transceiver FSM to progress; thus availability of the clock gating is an established property.

conceptual assets.concept: Transceiver internal state (rtx_engine.state, rtx_engine.bitcnt, rtx_engine.sreg) that sequences SPI transfers
conceptual assets.reasoning: The transceiver process implements an explicit FSM (rtx_engine.state) and associated counters/shift register (bitcnt, sreg) that determine when bytes are fetched from the TX FIFO, when bits are shifted out/in, and when a completed byte is written to the RX FIFO (RTL lines 266-336). Map: rtx_engine.state is a register with SELECTS and CLOCKED_BY records (e.g. occurrence 4, line 281 CLOCKED_BY clk_i and many SELECTS at line 282); rtx_engine.bitcnt is a stored counter (CLOCKED_BY at occurrence 4, line 311) used to assert done (map gates at line 319); rtx_engine.sreg is a stored shift register (CLOCKED_BY at occurrence 4, line 292) whose value is driven out (spi_dat_o) and pushed into rx_fifo on done. The FSM and these registers realize the sequencing decision the module depends on; corrupting them undermines correct SPI transfers, so integrity is Established.
